tasks.title: Three nights of real sleep
tasks.description: Phone in the kitchen drawer. Alarm off on Sunday. No deploys after 9pm — if prod pages you, someone else is on call.

tasks.title: Walk outside every lunch this week
tasks.description: Twenty minutes without Slack — rain or shine.

tasks.title: Protect a date night
tasks.description: Book it like a board meeting. No 'quick sync' cancellations.

tasks.title: Founder therapy session
tasks.description: Talk to someone who isn't your co-founder or investor. Bring the thing you almost said on the all-hands.

tasks.title: No-meeting Friday
tasks.description: Decline internals. Deep work or deep rest — your call.

tasks.title: Weekend without investor email
tasks.description: Auto-responder on. Batch replies Monday morning.

tasks.title: Four morning workouts
tasks.description: Lift, run, or yoga — before the standup spiral starts.

tasks.title: Cook dinner four nights
tasks.description: Skip the delivery apps. Eat at a table, not a desk.

tasks.title: Skip one batch happy hour
tasks.description: You don't owe every LP a beer. Rest beats networking FOMO.

tasks.title: Peer founder check-in (not pitch)
tasks.description: Compare notes on sleep and sanity — not term sheets.

tasks.title: Half-day hike off-campus
tasks.description: Marin, Mission Peak, or whatever gets you out of demo-day headspace.

tasks.title: Let COO run standup for a week
tasks.description: Show up only when paged. Practice not being the bottleneck.

tasks.title: Long weekend fully offline
tasks.description: Three days. Emergency number goes to your chief of staff — if you have one, otherwise truly offline.

tasks.title: Make the school play / game
tasks.description: Block investor calls that overlap. Be in the audience.

tasks.title: Revive a non-work hobby
tasks.description: Guitar, pottery, pickup basketball — something that isn't KPI-shaped.

tasks.title: Post-earnings walk (no CNBC)
tasks.description: Let IR handle the tape. You get thirty minutes of silence.

tasks.title: Delegate board deck first draft
tasks.description: Review on Thursday, not rewrite at 2am Wednesday.

tasks.title: Spa / massage reset day
tasks.description: Book recovery after a roadshow week — guilt-free.

tasks.title: Lunch with a mentor (no agenda)
tasks.description: Career advice counts as work-life balance when it lowers your blood pressure.

tasks.title: Say no to one feature request
tasks.description: Protect scope and your nervous system in the same breath.

tasks.title: Ten-day meditation streak
tasks.description: Ten minutes daily — Headspace, Calm, or sitting on the floor.

tasks.title: Work-from-home day with the dog
tasks.description: Office can survive without you in-person for one day.

tasks.title: Brunch with your partner (phones away)
tasks.description: No pitch practice at the table.

tasks.title: Executive coach session
tasks.description: Work on how you lead, not what you ship this sprint.

tasks.title: Skip the optional offsite social
tasks.description: Go home instead of the karaoke room. The team will survive.

tasks.title: Analyst day blackout
tasks.description: No sell-side calls for 48 hours after guidance.

tasks.title: Friends game night
tasks.description: Talk about anything except fundraising for three hours.

tasks.title: Personal volunteer day (not a photo op)
tasks.description: Serve meals or mentor — no press release.

tasks.title: Annual physical & labs
tasks.description: Founders ignore biomarkers until the board makes them go.

tasks.title: Full sabbath day (zero work)
tasks.description: 24 hours: no email, no Slack, no 'just checking metrics'.

tasks.title: Digital detox weekend
tasks.description: Laptop in a drawer, phone on grayscale, and zero founder Twitter.

tasks.title: Parents visit — no work laptop
tasks.description: They raised you before term sheets existed. Be present for it.

tasks.title: Morning pages for two weeks
tasks.description: Three pages longhand before you open Slack. Complaint dump included.

tasks.title: Sleep coach consult + plan
tasks.description: Oura guilt trips become actionable — bedtime you actually hit.

tasks.title: Join a local running club
tasks.description: Six a.m. strangers who don't ask your ARR. Show up three times.

tasks.title: Fiction-only audiobook commute
tasks.description: No founder memoirs, no market podcasts — just a plot.

tasks.title: Decline a podcast tour week
tasks.description: Your hot take can wait. Inbox autoresponder: 'in heads-down mode.'

tasks.title: Kids breakfast every day this week
tasks.description: Cereal, questions about dinosaurs, leave before the first standup.

tasks.title: Couples counseling session
tasks.description: Fix the thing you keep arguing about after midnight fundraise calls.

tasks.title: Four music lessons this month
tasks.description: Piano, guitar, or voice — progress measured in joy, not KPIs.

tasks.title: National park camping trip
tasks.description: No cell service on purpose. Bears don't care about your pipeline.

tasks.title: Join a non-business book club
tasks.description: Actual novels. Wine. Nobody mentions cap tables.

tasks.title: Log off social for a week
tasks.description: Delete the apps. Tell PR you'll be unreachable on the timeline.

tasks.title: Three float tank sessions
tasks.description: Sensory deprivation beats another late-night spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Walking 1:1 with a board member
tasks.description: Park loop instead of steak dinner. Same governance, fewer calories.

tasks.title: Hide the stock app for two weeks
tasks.description: Let IR watch the tape. You watch your kid's soccer game.

tasks.title: Sabbatical planning day (personal)
tasks.description: Map six weeks off — even if it's three years out. Hope counts.

tasks.title: CEO peer retreat (no shop talk)
tasks.description: Small group, Chatham House rules, zero pitch decks allowed.

tasks.title: 10am starts for two weeks
tasks.description: Team knows you're offline until standup. Sleep debt recovery mode.

tasks.title: Youth mentor session series
tasks.description: Four Saturdays with students who want careers, not your cap table story.

tasks.title: Walk campus — no donation ask
tasks.description: Visit your alma mater for nostalgia, not a giving officer meeting.

tasks.title: Home cooking class with partner
tasks.description: A instructor in your kitchen — phones in another room.

tasks.title: Take a real mental health day
tasks.description: Company calendar shows OOO. You actually rest, not 'catch up email'.

tasks.title: Co-founder coffee — no roadmap
tasks.description: Remember why you started. No cap table, no hiring plan, no passive-aggressive Slack subtext.

tasks.title: Dinner with a pre-startup friend
tasks.description: They knew you before the title. Let them roast your old haircut.

tasks.title: Bedtime routine all week
tasks.description: Stories, teeth, lights out — you present for all of it, laptop closed.

tasks.title: Sundays without work calls
tasks.description: Calendar block reads 'Unavailable'. Investors can wait until Monday 9am.

tasks.title: Trail day — no podcasts
tasks.description: Birds, not founder interviews. Phone stays in the car.

tasks.title: Decline a keynote season
tasks.description: Say no to three conference stages this quarter. Your product doesn't need another selfie.

tasks.title: Delegate the investor update draft
tasks.description: CFO or chief of staff writes v1. You only edit tone, not every metric.

tasks.title: Skip the demo-day afterparty
tasks.description: You pitched. Go home. The afterparty will happen again next batch.

tasks.title: Celebrate a shipped milestone IRL
tasks.description: Not a Slack emoji — cake, beers, or a walk with whoever helped you ship.

tasks.title: Sauna + cold plunge series
tasks.description: Four sessions. Sweat out the quarter, not your equity grant.

tasks.title: Three massage appointments
tasks.description: Shoulders that live at keyboard height deserve maintenance.

tasks.title: Creative writing four evenings
tasks.description: Fiction, poetry, or a journal — nothing that becomes a blog post.

tasks.title: Photography afternoon
tasks.description: Borrow a real camera. Shoot trees, not your dashboard.

tasks.title: Day trip with an aging parent
tasks.description: Drive, lunch, listen to the story you've heard — again — on purpose.

tasks.title: Bike commute twice a week
tasks.description: Helmet, route, no calls while pedaling. Legs instead of Lyft guilt.

tasks.title: Handwritten thank-yous to five people
tasks.description: Specific, not generic. Drop them on desks — no all-hands announcement.

tasks.title: Cancel one overpacked week
tasks.description: Move three external meetings. Protect sleep before you protect optics.

tasks.title: Celebrate your partner's career win
tasks.description: Their promotion, publication, or project ships — you host, you don't multitask.

tasks.title: Garden or yard weekend
tasks.description: Dirt under nails beats another dashboard refresh.

tasks.title: Two-week vacation (delegated)
tasks.description: Real OOO: exec team owns decisions. You return with stories, not inbox PTSD.

tasks.title: Post-earnings weekend away
tasks.description: After the call, leave town before you refresh Bloomberg every six minutes.

tasks.title: Volunteer shift (no gala speech)
tasks.description: Serve meals or tutor — skip the photo line and the branded step-and-repeat.

tasks.title: Eat lunch outside daily
tasks.description: Ten minutes of sun before the afternoon meeting avalanche.

tasks.title: Silent meditation retreat weekend
tasks.description: No talking, no email, no 'quick thought' Slack messages.

tasks.title: Attend the school play or game
tasks.description: Front row, phone off. They'll remember; the investor won't.

tasks.title: Book mentor time for yourself
tasks.description: You're not the mentor this hour — someone senior helps you untangle the job.

tasks.title: No screens in the bedroom month
tasks.description: Charge the phone in the hall. Read something that isn't a term sheet.
